reviews_data.review_text: The baristas are so nice! The environment is exquisite, super cool! They have pasteries, coffee, and records on vinyl! What more could you ask for?
Met the owner and the staff. Very welcoming and wonderful vibe. Can’t wait to come back soon
Perfect spot to unwind with friends — great vibes, good drinks.
